user.title: Car Tires Season
user.description: Set up where the car is driven. Weather sources are optional: without them the legal winter period and the calendar decide.

data_description.country: Decides which winter tire rules apply.
data_description.weather_entity: Provides the forecast and the current temperature.
data_description.temperature_entity: Optional. Used instead of the temperature of the weather entity.

region.title: Region
region.description: The rules differ by region. Leave it empty for all other regions.

data_description.weather_entity: Provides the forecast and the current temperature.
data_description.temperature_entity: Optional. Used instead of the temperature of the weather entity.
data_description.temperature_threshold: Average temperature below which winter tires are recommended (usually 7 °C).
data_description.forecast_days: How many days of forecast (or past days) are averaged.
data_description.notifications: Show a notification when it is time to change tires.
